title: Joint Application of Boston Edison Company, New England Power Company, Montaup Electric Company, Commonwealth Electric Company and Fitchburg Gas and Electric Light Company for approval by the Department pursuant to Massachusetts General Laws, Chapter 164, Section 97, as amended, of the sale, purchase, and reconveyance of certain rights and interests in land in Plymouth, Massachusetts, all in accordance with the terms of the Agreement For Reconveyance Between the Pilgrim Unit No. 2 Joint Owners, and a determination that the terms thereof are consistent with the public interest.
